components.title: Resource board
components.summary: A field-driven board projection of one flat resource collection into ordered lanes.

data_shape.lane_membership: Each item laneKey value equals one declared lanes[].id.

item.optional_projection: cardFields maps arbitrary typed resource fields without domain-specific card code

responsive.desktop: all lanes are equal peer columns when width permits
responsive.compact: lane order is preserved in a horizontally scrollable rail

interactions.query: Prefer dataSource.kind=resourceQuery for typed filters, search, sort, cursor, and relevance over Resource Workbench.
interactions.crud: Use action.type=resourceOperation for ordinary create/update/delete. action.target is resource_type; params.operation_id selects the declared operation.
interactions.button_scope: inputs.buttons are repeated on every card. Do not put a board-level Add command there; use the lane add event.
interactions.drag_drop: Set inputs.dragDrop=true and declare on=move. The event spreads displayed item fields at top level, including id and revision when supplied by the read, then adds fromLaneId, toLaneId, previousIndex, currentIndex, interaction, laneKey and patch. The lane value is already optimistic. For owned tools bind callSkill params.id=$event.id, revision=$event.revision and patch=$event.patch; not event.record.revision. The renderer awaits the action and rolls back on false/denied result or throw. Do not fetch a newer revision to overwrite a stale view. resourceOperation(update) remains supported for ordinary declarative mutations.
interactions.accessible_move: A lane selector is rendered with draggable cards so the same move is available without a dragging gesture.
interactions.lane_create: Declare on=add to expose one add command per lane. The event provides laneId and defaults containing the lane field, but never payload. When required fields must be entered, on=add opens a typed create form; it must not directly create from $event.payload.

limitations: The renderer never becomes data authority; Resource Workbench or a declared domain command applies mutations.
dragDrop=true requires an on=move persistence action; the renderer only provides optimistic feedback and rollback.
Images are optional and should not be invented unless the request makes imagery relevant.
postconditions: One rendered lane exists for every declared lane in declaration order.
Every item is rendered in the lane selected by laneKey.
Unknown lane values are reported by validation rather than silently dropped.

components.title: List and card collection
components.summary: Rows, grouped rows, or a responsive card catalog without workflow-lane semantics.

manifest.row_state: For flat list rows, inputs.disabledKey names a boolean field that disables activation; inputs.currentKey names a separate boolean field that bolds the title and marks aria-current=step. Current work is independent of selected detail. Selection and row-button events expose row fields directly as $event.<field>, not $event.item.<field>.
manifest.value_labels: meta entries support valueLabels as authored choice fallbacks, or optionsDataSource.kind=resourceQuery with optionValuePath and optionLabelPaths for live related-record captions. Unknown identities remain visible as canonical values; display never changes stored IDs.

limitations: Separate list widgets do not form a semantic Kanban board.
postconditions: Every visible collection item has a stable focus identity.

components.title: Dense table
components.summary: A dense comparison of typed textual, status, boolean, icon, and action columns.

manifest.column_display: columns[*].overflow=wrap|truncate and align=start|center|end are retained at widget ingress. Date, datetime and number cells stay unbroken unless overflow is explicit. Columns support valueI18nPrefix with valueLabels fallback, or optionsDataSource.kind=resourceQuery with optionValuePath and optionLabelPaths for live related-record captions; canonical stored IDs are unchanged.

postconditions: Declared columns map to rendered cells in declaration order.

columns[*].sortable=true enables local sorting before pagination; inputs.sort={key,direction} selects the initial order. Sorting is unavailable for server-paginated data. kind=datetime formats an ISO timestamp in the active locale and local timezone.

Page size and declared filter modes persist within the active subnet, page scope and widget identity. inputs.preferences=false disables persistence; inputs.preferences.filterStateKeys adds explicit scalar filter modes. Search, selection, records and cursors are not persisted. inputs.refresh=true adds a targeted datasource reload button.

components.title: Typed form
components.summary: Typed data capture with validation and bounded form lifecycle actions.

manifest.layout_property: inputs.layout is an optional string enum: stack, responsiveGrid, responsive-grid, grid, or auto-grid. It is not a page layout object.
manifest.conditional_required: Set required=true on the dependent field and use a string visibleIf expression such as $state.result === 'defect'. ui.form evaluates the expression against a snapshot that includes sibling form values and validates visible required fields before submit. Never use an object-shaped condition or synthesize errors with updateState.
manifest.record_editor: A resourceQuery with query.id=$state.<selection> loads the selected record into local fields. Empty selection means create mode, not the first returned record. inputs.buttons[*].id dispatches only matching actions[*].id in declaration order. Post-success steps share that SAME id; on=submit alone does not bind them. False/throw (including cancelled confirmation) stops the sequence. Multiple unrelated submit mutations must never execute together. Declared button enabledIf controls availability. closeOnSuccess dismisses the editor only after a successful command.
manifest.state_initialized_creation: A form without dataSource hydrates fields from page state using each field's stateKey (alias state_key), defaulting to form.<widget.id>.<field.id>. Before opening a creation modal, updateState initializes draft-specific keys, including a selected parent, and clears old values. defaultValue/default/value are literals, not $state expressions. A dataSource form instead loads the selected record; it does not hydrate page-state fields, and an empty selected id ignores returned records. Use a separate state-initialized create form when parent defaults are needed. Show the parent caption through live choices or an explicitly bound read-only caption.
manifest.read_only_record: inputs.readOnlyIf is evaluated against the stored selected record, not the draft or page state. The Prototype resource provider enforces the same declared read_only_when predicate before update/delete.
manifest.live_choices: A choice field may use optionsDataSource.kind=resourceQuery, optionValuePath and optionLabelPaths. Automation also admits kind=skill with name, params and invalidationTags; return an array or {items:[...]}. Related record invalidation refreshes options without resetting the draft; unavailable or malformed options block submission and expose retry. Prototype relationships validate current references atomically, including deletion of referenced targets. Collection filter options remain seed-based pending separate live-lookup qualification. Read-only captions in tables, list metadata and details support Resource Workbench sources; absent captions expose the canonical identity.
manifest.free_form_string_lists: tagInput captures an ordered, deduplicated string array from comma or Enter-delimited values. Use it for open vocabularies such as scopes, roles, identifiers, and evidence references; use chips only for a closed predefined option set.
manifest.prototype_attachments: fileUpload with fileStorage=prototype uploads bytes through the authenticated Preview resource endpoint and stores a string reference (or array for multiple=true). Submit waits for upload; failure retains the old value. Limits: 10 MiB/file, 64 MiB/resource.
manifest.production_attachments: fileUpload with fileStorage=skill, qualified uploadTarget/readTarget from the same owned skill, and maxBytes <= 10485760 sends raw bytes through the normal authorized tool ingress. The upload tool consumes the one-use binary context into storage.blob; the read tool authorizes retrieval. The stored value is an authenticated /api/tools/... attachment reference. Without fileStorage, forms collect metadata only.

responsive.compact: one column when fields no longer fit

postconditions: Every required answer is represented by a typed field.

components.title: Selected item details
components.summary: A readable field projection for one selected or bound record.

manifest.value_labels: Field entries support valueLabels as authored choice fallbacks, or optionsDataSource.kind=resourceQuery with optionValuePath and optionLabelPaths for live related-record captions. Unknown identities remain visible; labels do not mutate records.
manifest.media: inputs.mediaKey binds an image/video/audio source on the selected record. Optional mediaKindKey selects image, video or audio; mediaPosterKey binds a poster. Native controls, loading, unavailable and empty states are provided. A filename field without mediaKey is not a viewer.
manifest.commands: Actions sharing named on=click:<command> execute in declaration order; awaited false/throw stops the sequence. Label one step to expose one button. Generic on=click actions remain independent. enabledIf guards the command; repeated clicks are blocked while it is pending.

postconditions: When selectedStateKey is used, visible details change with that selected key.

components.title: Hierarchy tree
components.summary: Hierarchical navigation for files, lifecycle nodes, and nested domain records.
postconditions: Every selectable leaf provides all fields consumed by its select action.

components.title: Command surface
components.summary: Explicit toolbar, segmented, stack, compact, or automatically overflowing commands.

interactions.menu: adaptiveToolbar buttons with options use a viewport-bounded overlay. Selection emits select:<buttonId> with the option as $event (id/value/menu_id), not $event.option. displaySelectedLabel=false keeps a short authored trigger label; optionMetaPaths chooses localized secondary option fields. An option with current=true marks the actual current step in bold and with aria-current, independently of the selected item being inspected. disabled=true prevents selecting an unavailable option. Selection does not execute another command implicitly.
interactions.overflow: variant=autoOverflow keeps required and higher-priority plain commands visible, moves remaining commands into one keyboard-accessible More menu, and recomputes on container resize. Mark a command overflow=never when it owns a nested option menu or must remain visible.

responsive.compact: wraps or uses one explicit overflow menu without overlapping

postconditions: Every declared button has an executable or explicitly disabled action contract.

A static menu may opt into rememberSelection=true with a top-level selectedStateKey for presentation preferences. The browser remembers only a declared scalar option, isolated by subnet/page/widget/button. Restoring never dispatches actions; unknown saved values are ignored. Do not persist workflow authority, entity selection, drafts or secrets this way.

components.title: Collection search and filters
components.summary: Compact page-scoped query controls with filter disclosure, active values and atomic reset.

responsive.desktop: search and commands in one row, expandable filter grid

interactions.state: Each inputs.controls entry binds one stateKey in the current page scope. Bind the collection resourceQuery to the same $state key. Date commits on native change; numbers and boolean options retain their types.

postconditions: Reset clears all owned query keys in one update without clearing unrelated page state.

components.title: Boolean toggle
components.summary: One explicit binary setting with a boolean change event.

interactions.event: The change event is {value:boolean, checked:boolean}; bind page state with $event.checked.

postconditions: The visible checked state and emitted value are boolean.

components.title: Option selector
components.summary: One compact selectable option set with optional search.
postconditions: The selected value maps to one declared option value.

components.title: Section tabs
components.summary: A semantic tab list for switching peer sections within one surface.

manifest.selection: Use selectedStateKey on buttons and click:<buttonId> actions to update the active section.

postconditions: The active tab is exposed through aria-selected.
ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, and End move keyboard focus between enabled tabs.

components.title: Breadcrumb navigation
components.summary: A compact hierarchy path with an explicit current location.

responsive.compact: horizontally scrollable path without label overlap

postconditions: The last or explicitly current item uses aria-current=page.
Navigation labels may truncate visually but retain their full accessible name.

components.title: Accordion disclosure
components.summary: A bounded list of independently disclosed information sections.
postconditions: Each trigger exposes aria-expanded and owns one labelled region.
Single-open is the default; multiple=true explicitly enables multiple open sections.

components.title: Metric chart
components.summary: A bounded chart projection for metric or timeseries values.
postconditions: A non-empty numeric series produces a non-blank chart.

recipes.title: Kanban resource board
recipes.summary: Map any typed resource collection into explicit ordered workflow lanes.

inputs.laneKey: Resource field containing a lane id.
inputs.cardFields: Optional typed field projections shown on compact cards.

dataSource.forbidden_kind: local_crud is a provider mode, never a WebUI dataSource.kind

composition.visual_rule: Use compact text-first cards. Add images only when the request explicitly makes imagery relevant.

interactions.drag_drop: Set inputs.dragDrop=true and declare an on=move persistence action. Prefer resourceOperation(update) with record_id=$event.id and payload=$event.patch for ordinary field changes.
interactions.crud: Compose resourceQuery, resourceOperation, ui.form, and item.details before adding skill-specific handlers.

postconditions: The page contains one collection.board widget.
The declared lane count equals the requested column count.
Every requested sample card belongs to exactly one declared lane.
Every lane contains the requested number of sample cards when specified.

recipes.title: Resource board workbench
recipes.summary: Compose query controls, a board projection, record details, and typed CRUD over one Resource Workbench definition.

composition.query: Toolbar controls write typed search/filter/sort values to page state; resourceQuery consumes those values.
composition.board: collection.board projects query items by laneKey and writes selection to state.
composition.details: item.details or a modal reads the selected resource record; ui.form edits it.
composition.operations: resourceOperation implements create/update/delete and lane-field updates; domain commands remain separate.

prototype.provider_mode: The separate PrototypeData artifact uses mode=local_crud; never put local_crud in WebUI dataSource.kind.
prototype.records: Return prototype_records beside webui in adaos.builder.webui_result.v1 so Builder can materialize the disposable provider.
prototype.forms: Use ui.form inputs.fields with formInputType values. For a choice field use select, dropdown, or combobox; selector is invalid and input.selector is a separate standalone widget.

board_create_entry.rule: The create-item modal contains a ui.form with title and laneKey fields; do not add a repeated per-card Add button.

prototype.modal_rule: When openModal is used, declare that exact literal id under ui.application.modals and provide a schema object containing widgets. In a complete JSON document use create-item, never @create-item; @<id> is reserved for JSON Patch pointer paths.

postconditions: Changing a query control changes the resource query rather than filtering an unrelated client copy.
Selecting a card identifies one stable resource record for details or editing.
Ordinary CRUD does not require a generated skill-specific handler.
Every mutation is checked against the ResourceDefinition operation and role policy.

recipes.title: Resource collection workbench
recipes.summary: Compose a list or table, record details, and typed local CRUD over one generic Prototype resource.

composition.scope: This recipe materializes exactly one Prototype resource. Use static bounded reference choices unless another admitted recipe explicitly declares multiple resources.
composition.collection: Use ui.list or ui.table with widget.dataSource.kind=resourceQuery and one prototype.<resource_name> resourceType. dataSource is a widget peer of inputs, never inputs.dataSource.
composition.selection: Write the selected stable record id to page state and use the same id for details and updates.
composition.operations: Put resourceOperation declarations in widget.actions for create, update, and delete. updateState alone is not persistence.

prototype.records: Return prototype_records beside WebUI so Builder can derive and materialize the disposable local CRUD provider.

postconditions: Mutations target the same prototype resourceType used by the collection query.
Every requested mutation has a resourceOperation instead of a decorative state-only action.
Ordinary local CRUD does not require a generated skill-specific handler.

recipes.title: Master and detail
recipes.summary: Select one collection item and show a state-bound detail surface.

composition.selection: Master writes selected id; details read the same id.

postconditions: Selecting different master records changes the visible detail record.

recipes.title: Typed data entry
recipes.summary: Capture a typed record and expose explicit lifecycle actions.
postconditions: Each requested answer has one editable typed field.

recipes.title: Operational dashboard
recipes.summary: Compose independent metrics and summaries in a responsive area grid.

composition.layout: Independent peer areas using pattern=dashboard or grid.

postconditions: Metric areas use a grid render plan on a sufficiently wide viewport.
